vectors.name: lead_location_state_region_only_accepted

vectors.name: lead_compliance_otp_planted_code
vectors.description: compliance.otp carries the correctly-hashed verification plus a planted plaintext 'code' property (842314). SPEC §3: the actual OTP code MUST NOT be included — it is ephemeral and poses a replay risk. The closed otp object (additionalProperties:false) must reject; control: L2-016 differs only in dropping code.

vectors.name: lead_compliance_otp_hash_and_timestamp_accepted

vectors.name: ping_compliance_flags_planted_token
vectors.description: Valid ping (L2-009 base) whose compliance_flags gain an unknown consent_evidence_token carrying a bearer-JWT-shaped string. SPEC §4: compliance_flags are presence indicators only — never tokens or evidence. The object stays open (new boolean flags must pass, see L2-018) so closure cannot catch this; the conformance runner's presence-indicator check must.

vectors.name: ping_compliance_flags_presence_indicators_accepted
vectors.description: Control for L2-017: compliance_flags carrying known booleans plus one unknown boolean presence flag (mfa_verified) — presence indicators are open-extensible; every value is a boolean, so the runner must accept.
